div.div: خَجْلَةٌ : see 1: [it seems to be most probably a subst. signifying Confusion, or perplexity, and inability to see one's right course, by reason of shame: or shame, and confusion, or perplexity, and inability to see one's right course, in consequence of a deed that one has done: or simply,] i. q. حَيَآءٌ [shame, or a sense of shame, &c.]. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
